steps.title: Что работа требует, а что нет
steps.html:
He had to be polite to the customers. — правило пришло извне. Выбора не было.

He didn't have to take much responsibility. — такого правила не было. Мог бы, но никто не требовал.

He isn't allowed to leave the kitchen during a service. — это запрещено.

He can take home some very good food. — это разрешено и приятно.

steps.title: В каком предложении говорится, что такого правила нет?
options: You don't have to wear a uniform.
You aren't allowed to wear a uniform.
steps.answer: You don't have to wear a uniform.
steps.why: Mustn't и aren't allowed to запрещают. Don't have to просто снимает обязанность.

steps.title: Обязанность, разрешение, запрет
steps.html:
ФормаЗначитПример
have toправило приходит извнеHe has to manage a team.
mustговорящий сам считает это важным, или это писаное правилоHe must work to tight deadlines.
don't have toобязанности нет — ваш выборHe doesn't have to work outside.
can / be allowed toэто разрешеноHe can take food home.
can't / not allowed toэто запрещеноHe isn't allowed to leave the kitchen.

steps.title: Пара, которую путают чаще всего
steps.html:
mustn't = нельзя. don't have to = можно и не делать, никто не требует.

You mustn't tell the customers — запрет. You don't have to tell the customers — на ваше усмотрение.

be allowed to нужна там, где у can формы нет: We weren't allowed to…, You'll be allowed to…

steps.title: Четыре недели подготовки против многолетнего опыта. Чего вы ждёте?
Faking it
steps.html:
Прочитайте один раз. Заметьте, каким навыкам, по мнению автора, научить нельзя.

A television programme takes someone with no experience at all, gives them four weeks with an expert, and then sends them into a contest against professionals. A panel of judges has to decide which of the participants is the real thing. The surprising part is how often the judges get it wrong.

Ed is the example everyone remembers. Before the programme he had been working in a burger van. He had to be reliable and turn up on time, and he had to be polite to the customers, but that was the whole job: his boss dealt with the money, so he didn't have to take much responsibility, and he didn't need to get up early because the van opened at eleven.

Four weeks later he was being trained as a chef. Now he has to manage a team, which he finds harder than the cooking, and he must work to very tight deadlines. He isn't allowed to leave the kitchen while a service is running. On the other hand, he doesn't have to work outside in the rain any more, and he can take home some very good food when the restaurant closes.

What the programme really shows is which skills transfer and which do not. The technique can be taught in four weeks. Being precise, working well under pressure, setting goals, thinking ahead and staying pleasant when a customer is difficult cannot — those come with the person. One of the instructors put it simply: you can teach anyone to cook an egg, but you can't teach them to care whether it is any good.

Ed did not win his contest. He came second, and he was shocked to realize that he couldn't say please and thank you all the time if he wanted the team to respect him. He is still in the kitchen five years later, which is more than most of the winners managed.

Being precise, working well under pressure, setting goals, thinking ahead and staying pleasant when a customer is difficult cannot — those come with the person. One of the instructors put it simply: you can teach anyone to cook an egg, but you can't teach them to care whether it is any good.

Ed did not win his contest. He came second, and he was shocked to realize that he couldn't say please and thank you all the time if he wanted the team to respect him. He is still in the kitchen five years later, which is more than most of the winners managed.

items.text: You can… if you want to.

steps.title: Ответьте вслух.
items: Опишите свою или знакомую работу: три обязанности, одно необязательное, одно запрещённое.
Каким навыкам из текста можно научить за четыре недели, а каким нет?
Вы бы участвовали в такой программе? Почему?

steps.title: Теперь опишите работу одним высказыванием. Запишите себя.
steps.sub: Используйте have to, don't have to и be allowed to хотя бы по разу.
items: In my job you have to … and you must … .
You don't have to … , and you're not allowed to … .
The skill you can't teach is … .

steps.title: Урок 8 пройден
items: Я говорю, что обязан, не обязан и что мне разрешено.
Я различаю mustn't и don't have to.
Я по-прежнему верно выбираю форму способности, когда обе встречаются вместе.
Я описываю нужные для работы навыки, используя составные прилагательные.
